judgments.case_name: V. Shankar Ram vs Mrs. Sukanya
judgments.facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 27.11.1988 at Guruvayoor. The husband set up a matrimonial home in Madras after marriage. He claimed that his wife did not adjust well and he filed an appeal against the trial court's judgment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to annul a marriage to prove that the consent was obtained by misrepresentation and fraud.
legal_principles.held: The appellant has not made out any case and specifically proved that certain false representations were made to him concerning the material particulars of the respondent at the time of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage is not liable to be declared null and void solely because it was not consummated.
legal_principles.held: The Family Court held that the appellant has not substantiated his contention that the marriage was not consummated owing to the impotency of the respondent.
